what: null-calibrated cross-expert participation on every reachable MoE-float body
method: participation ratio of the layer's expert stack against a GAUSSIAN NULL CARRYING THE SAME PER-ROW NORMS. The shipped threshold (ratio < 0.95 = sharing LIVE) is the noise floor at n=20 and reports LIVE on pure noise below it, so a constant cannot decide this. Gram accumulated in feature blocks to stay under Metal's watchdog; one shard resident at a time; per-body memory expectation computed from headers and cleared with the campaign guard before each run.

refutation_test_run_and_failed.prediction: the five unmeasured bodies all stored experts STACKED -- a 3D tensor with the expert axis first -- and that was recorded as the only structural difference left untested, hence the obvious place a counterexample would live.
refutation_test_run_and_failed.result: two stacked bodies were measured. Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B at n=128 gives +0.002% and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Abliterated at n=512 gives +0.002% -- indistinguishable from the per-expert bodies. STORAGE LAYOUT MAKES NO DIFFERENCE. The prediction was tested against its own stated refutation condition and the condition was not met.

finding.consequence: eight bodies, six families, five vendors, expert counts spanning 8x, bodies spanning 30.6 to 335.3 GiB, and both storage layouts -- every one within 0.007% of its own norm-matched null. No residual linear structure exists for a shared basis, common+delta, clustering or alignment to find in any of them. This is an architecture-family LAW with six independent confirmations, reached with no training run and no capability evaluation, at under 2 seconds and under 2 GiB peak RSS per body.
finding.what_would_still_refute_it: an MoE body whose expert stack sits 2% or more below its norm-matched null. Six families and both layouts have failed to produce one. Remaining untested: a pre-quantized expert organ after dequantization, which is a different obligation.

why_nine_were_not_measured.note: six bodies store experts STACKED (a 3D tensor with the expert axis first) or under w1/w13 names, which the per-expert regex cannot address. That is the scheme-table work now in flight. Two were refused by the campaign guard with 2.8 and 3.6 GB free while two Grok lanes held memory -- a refusal, not a failure.

g035_streaming_proof.claim: a body larger than RAM is anatomisable organ-by-organ, and it is not close
g035_streaming_proof.vs_host: 2.9x the MEASURED 72 GiB Metal wired ceiling; 2.1x the 96 GB machine
g035_streaming_proof.header_index: 18,329 tensors across 47 shards, built in under 0.1s, payload untouched
g035_streaming_proof.mechanism: read every shard's header to map tensor -> shard, open only the shards holding the target organ, and hold ONE at a time. The expert stack for one layer is the working set, not the body.
g035_streaming_proof.peak_honesty: free_gb_low is null because the run finished in 0.72s, shorter than the 1.0s sampler interval. An unknown peak is reported as unknown rather than as the entry reading.

memory_halving.problem: calibrated() held the real f32 stack and its null simultaneously, so the guard refused this body twice at 9.5 GB expected against 8.8-9.4 GB free
memory_halving.fix: the null needs the per-row NORMS and the shape, nothing else. row_norms() then free X then null_from_norms() halves peak: 9.5 GB expected became 5.8, moving the guard from STOP to WARN and permitting the run while two Grok lanes held the rest of the machine.
memory_halving.equivalence: two-phase is asserted BIT-IDENTICAL to one-shot in the selfcheck, because a memory saving bought with a different measurement is not a saving. The mutation that stops applying the norms diverges the deficit -0.002 against -0.004.
